svg.title: The graph behind it: from the findspot back to a place

g.text: the tephra leads from one place to another — and the second is itself a findspot of the same dataset
862 km away · findspot 22 of the same dataset
the same row, however, lands exactly on
the same structure — only here every edge ends in a sentence instead of an identifier
geolod:Cave · geolod:elevation_m 550 · no skos:closeMatch, no owl:sameAs
“Type site for Homo floresiensis” sits in
the dataset as free text. Without a QID
the statement can neither be confirmed nor
refuted from outside — which is exactly
what the identifiers did for findspots 22
placed by its coordinate, not by a statement
